title: ResourceErasureRefused
description:
`resource_erasure_refused` — the negative face of resource erasure and of the block history
scrub (resource erasure spec D5, D11). Keyed on the resource, spelled as [`ResourceErased`]
spells it: every reason is a fact about the resource, whichever act was refused.

act.description: Which act was refused. Absent means [`ErasureAct::Erasure`].

blocks.description:
The blocks a refused block history scrub named. Carried here, never in `subject_ids` or
`detail`; empty for an erasure refusal.

detail.description: The reason's evidence, e.g. the task that owns map-grain charter erasure.

AnchorTable.description: A polymorphic anchor/endpoint reference. Serializes table names exactly as the DDL spells them.

ErasureAct.description:
Which act a `resource_erasure_refused` event refuses. Absent on the payload reads as
[`ErasureAct::Erasure`].

oneOf.description:
The field scrub: a resource's title, origin URI or property history redacted while the
resource survives.

RecordedRefusalReason.description:
The closed refusal vocabulary `resource_erasure_refused` records (resource erasure spec D5,
D11; field-grain scrub spec S4): every value either act family's doors answer with. A ledger
vocabulary only; no door answers in it.
